title: Brussels, one waffle at a time
post_caption: Day 4 in Brussels. Atomium in the morning, Grand Place lit up by evening, and a waffle stop that turned into the highlight of the day. Whipped cream, chocolate drizzle, not one plate came back full.

One of our teachers, keeping count.
